ChangeNameBtn.tip: Search and replace in the selected names.
ChangeNameBtn.what: Replaces the Search text with the Replace text in the selected node names.
examples: Search "L_", replace "R_" on a copied left side.

ChangeNameBtn2.tip: Search and replace in the whole hierarchy.
ChangeNameBtn2.what: Same as Name, but also renames every child of the selection.
examples: Select the top group of a duplicated arm and swap L_ for R_ in one go.
Rename a whole duplicated leg hierarchy to the right side.
ChangeNameBtn2.details: mel searchReplaceNames <search> <replace> "hierarchy" on each selected node.

prefixBtn.tip: Add the prefix to the selection.
prefixBtn.what: Adds the prefix text plus "_" in front of each selected name.
examples: Prefix "Old" on nodes before a swap.
prefixBtn.details: <prefix>_<name> for each selected node; the selection is kept on the renamed nodes.

RenameBtn.what: Gives the selection the new name, numbered when the number check is on.
steps: Select in the order you want the numbers.
Type the name, turn numbers on.
examples: Select 5 joints, type "Tail", check numbers: Tail_01 ... Tail_05.
Name a new tail chain Tail_01 to Tail_10.
RenameBtn.details: Renames to a temp name first so swapping names does not clash, then <name>_<num> (when numbers are on).

sufixBtn.tip: Add the suffix to the selection.
sufixBtn.what: Adds "_" plus the suffix text at the end of each selected name.

right.what: Adds the right side prefix (R) to the selected names.
examples: Select the right arm joints and click it.
Prefix the right side joints of a mirrored chain.
right.details: Fills the prefix field with the right side name from the naming config and runs Prefix.

left.what: Adds the left side prefix (L) to the selected names.
examples: Select the left arm joints and click it.
left.details: Fills the prefix field with the left side name from the naming config and runs Prefix.

ctrl.what: Adds the controller suffix (_Ctrl) to the selected names so Mutant finds them.
examples: Select the curves you drew and click it.
Suffix new curves so Mutant treats them as ctrls.
ctrl.details: Fills the suffix field with the controller name from the naming config and runs Suffix.

joint.what: Adds the joint suffix (_Jnt) to the selected names.
examples: Select joints made by hand and click it.
joint.details: Fills the suffix field with the joint name from the naming config and runs Suffix.
